global_limits: Public receipts are source-bound controller attestations, not independent host token inspection.
Deleted private reports/PCAPs are not reconstructible from this index. No raw identities, paths, nonces, handles, endpoint tuples or credentials are included.
TCP/UDP packet observations, IPC transport, synthetic HTTP and real proxy networking are distinct claims.
No DNS/broker isolation, browser compatibility, arbitrary descendants, universal egress prevention, peer authentication or full Windows/Linux equivalence is established.
No new execution is authorized by this index. Windows Codex must inspect pinned source and obtain authority for any local profile/ACL/process/network test.
